description:
Meet Ana in this visual novel, an 8-year-old girl with a deep curiosity about nature. One day, while playing in her grandmother's garden, she discovers a secret door that leads her to a magical garden filled with talking animals.

With the help of her dog Rocco, a mischievous and always energetic dog, Nina, a colorful and cheerful hummingbird, and Max, a cheerful and brave fox, Ana must help the animals remember what makes this place special: friendship, teamwork, and a love of nature.

Kid- and family-friendly gameplay.

Accessible text and narrative for young readers.

Dynamic and colorful images inspired by fantasy worlds.

Ambient music creates a magical and immersive atmosphere.

Lessons about teamwork, courage, and the power of stories.

Accessibility options such as adjusting text, volume, and image transitions.

·Educational fun with content that promotes positive values.
name: The Guardians of the Secret Garden
intro: A journey through a magical garden, which needs help. An adventurous girl and her dog will seek to restore peace with the help of new friends.
